<description>
On the master branch @ 17817818da3cb67c95320b7a5d4d69bd649c1fbf, building on a RISC-V system [fails](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36232):
```
guix shell: error: package python-lief@0.17.5 does not support riscv64-linux
```

Also see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34550#issuecomment-3921035276.

This is caused by the `python-msgspec` package, an indirect dependency of `python-lief`:

`python-lief` <-- `python-scikit-build-core` <-- `python-cattrs` <-- `python-msgspec`

Also see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34550#issuecomment-3926767282.

This [commit](https://codeberg.org/guix/guix/commit/b35905695afd2e24c56e6950433dd4f571581873) updates `python-msgspec` and removes `(supported-systems (list "x86_64-linux" "aarch64-linux"))` from its definition.

Package updates:
- `git-minimal`: 2.52.0 -> 2.54.0
- `linux-headers` 6.1.166 -> 6.1.172
- `python-lief`:  0.17.5 -> 0.17.6
- `python-minimal`: 3.11.14 -> 3.12.12

Fixes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36232.

---

Drafted until I make Guix builds on my RISC-V machine, which might take time.
